description: Wind-turbine power curves (kW against hub-height wind speed at the IEC 61400-12-1 reference air density 1.225 kg/m3) for woof energy power. Speeds between points are linearly interpolated. curve_source 'oedb' is an upstream manufacturer curve; 'parametric' is P/P_r = s/(1+s^n)^(1/n), s = 0.5 rho0 cp v^3 / SP, cp 0.45, n 8, zero below 3 m/s, at the model's specific power. Cut-out is applied with hysteresis at run time.
attribution: Contains data from the Open Energy Platform Wind Turbine Library (c) Reiner Lemoine Institut, ODbL-1.0, via the windpowerlib oedb snapshot; supplementary ratings and rotor diameters from manufacturer publications. This derived database is made available under ODbL-1.0.
